source.title: The Ashbringer
source.description:
Your hand trembles as it closes on the hilt of the shattered blade. You hold the remnants of a truly legendary weapon, the Ashbringer. Holding what remains of the sword fills you with a sense of icy dread, and you could swear that you hear voices in your mind. One voice in particular rings the loudest.

<If you would see it restored, take up the broken blade. This road may only lead to damnation, but I will show you the way.>
source.completion:
Good, you have taken the first step.

I am an echo of the original owner of the Ashbringer. Something of a... witness to the folly of those who think that simply wielding legendary weapons will make themselves legendary. Caldoran fell into this trap, and oblivion was his reward.

As for you, perhaps you could be different? You could do better. Or you could fail like so many others, and reach for power over principle in the same vainglorious aspirations.
